title: Page replacement algorithms
objectives: Compare common page replacement strategies (FIFO, LRU, clock algorithm)
Explain the trade-offs between replacement frequency and overhead

blocks.text: When a page fault occurs and no free frame is available, the operating system must select a victim page for replacement. FIFO replaces the oldest loaded page, LRU replaces the least recently used page, and the clock algorithm approximates LRU with lower overhead by giving each page a reference bit.
